title: Granular Access Control for Data Analytics
business: A data analytics firm managing sensitive client datasets across multiple departments.
problem: Over-privileged service accounts allow developers to accidentally delete production datasets, increasing risk of data loss.
solution: Implementing Google Cloud IAM to enforce the principle of least privilege by assigning specific roles to service accounts based on functional requirements.
steps: Identify the specific actions required for the data processing service account.
Select predefined IAM roles that map to these minimal required actions.
Apply the IAM policy to the specific project or resource level.
Audit existing permissions to remove broad 'Editor' or 'Owner' roles.
outcome: Reduced blast radius for accidental resource deletion and improved compliance posture.
limitation: IAM policies can become complex to manage at scale; verify effectiveness using the Policy Intelligence tool to identify overly permissive access.
